evidence.title: GitHub - pbakaus/impeccable: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.

name: Impeccable
summary: Design guidance for AI coding agents: one skill, 24 commands and 59 detector rules for frontend work.
description: A design language for AI coding agents, installed with npx impeccable. One /impeccable skill exposes 24 commands (polish, critique, audit, distill, animate, bolder, quieter ...); init records durable product truth in PRODUCT.md, live mode iterates on elements in the browser, and 59 deterministic detector rules plus LLM-only critique checks flag AI-generated frontend tells. Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Grok and more.
contains: 24 skills on skills.sh (1 skill, 24 slash commands)
59 deterministic detector rules plus LLM critique checks
